services.name: Whale Watch
services.desc: Hawaii Humpback whales are mammals belonging to the order Cetacea, which includes whales, dolphins, and porpoises. The common name "Humpback" refers to the high arch of their backs when the whales dive. Hawaiian Humpbacks weigh about 40 tons and can be up to 50 feet in length; females are slightly larger than the males. The average life span of a Humpback is between 30 and 40 years, with the oldest whale on record estimated to be 48 years old. Helped by its mother, a newborn Humpback instinctively swims to the surface within 10 seconds for its first breath.
